thread:
Maria: Heads up — we've got a weird routing bifurcation on the canary. ~12% of requests from the same session are landing on the old variant intermittently.
Tom: Seeing it in metrics too. canary traffic = 10% expected, but backend logs show 9% baseline, 1% canary, and 2% mismatched sticky redirects.
Jake: Is this the header-based split where we use X-Client-Env then cookie fallback? Could be normalization.
Maria: I dug into the edge logs. Looks like header casing + whitespace from a proxy caused the hash key to change. Example from logs:
```
req_id=abcd user=acct-123 X-Client-Env="Canary " route_hash=0x9f2b -> baseline
req_id=efgh user=acct-123 X-Client-Env="canary" route_hash=0x4a8c -> canary
```
Maria: Note the trailing space in the first one.
Tom: Oof. That explains hash mismatch. Our hash input is literally header|cookie|ip. If header differs by case/trim we flip buckets.
Jake: Can we normalize headers in the routing layer (lowercase + trim) before hashing? Should be safe.
Maria: Proposed quick patch:
```yaml
routing:
  inputs: ["header:X-Client-Env", "cookie:session_affinity"]
  normalize:
    header: lower_trim
```
Tom: Also need to decide guard precedence. Right now cookie affinity is winning even when header indicates explicit canary opt-in. We should have explicit header opt-in override cookie.
Jake: Agreed. Change ordering to: explicit header opt-in -> rollout guard -> cookie affinity -> ip fallback.
Maria: @deploy-bot started a canary push earlier at 2101112200 — maybe the proxy change happened in that release chain.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for service=inference-router image=router:v3.4.1 -- tags=[edge-normalize]
Tom: If proxy introduced trailing spaces (legacy lib), we should add a middleware trim as emergency hotfix and then a config change in the router.
Maria: I pushed a hotfix branch with header normalization + guard reordering. Can someone run a quick smoke? Patch diff:
```
- hash_input = header + cookie
+ hash_input = normalize(header) + cookie
+ guard_order = [header_opt_in, rollout_percentage, cookie_affinity, ip]
```
Jake: Running smoke on staging now.
sre-bot: alert: increased 5xxs on router-staging between 2101112245-2101112250, investigating
Jake: Staging traffic looks stable post-fix, can confirm headers normalized and no bifurcation in local replay.
Tom: LGTM for hotfix. Rollforward plan? Apply to edge proxies first, then router to avoid imbalanced hashes.
Maria: Will coordinate with infra. Also adding telemetry to log normalized header value and pre/post-hash key so we can trace future drifts. :eyes:
Jake: Nice. Can we add a regression test that injects whitespace/case variants into header fuzzing suite?
Maria: Yes — adding to rollout-e2e. Thanks team. Will post follow-up once prod patch is live.
Tom: Thanks — nice catch Maria :thumbsup:
